name: atelier
description: Frontend design method and UI/UX auditor for Claude Code.

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Research-led frontend design method plus an evidence-first UI/UX auditor. `atelier` is the doctrine for building sites that do not look generated; `ui-audit` measures an existing interface — a static pass over the repository and a real-Chrome pass over the running page — before anyone forms an opinion about it.
